QUOTE: When the second `llama_tokenize` returns a negative value (line 64), `LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize` logs an error containing only the text length and returns `{}`, an empty vector.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a negative result from the second call logs an error and returns an empty vector, and it says explicitly that "The failure path does not retry at all."
